activation_base_rule: exact current integration head that records T10 and T11 APPROVED and integrated
activation_steps: Verify authoritative integration branch is codex/havenline-sequential-task-01.
Verify T07, T08, T10 and T11 are APPROVED in dependency graph, workstream registry and task gates.
Verify the current integration head contains accepted T10 and T11 completion/integration records.
Verify T10 and T11 are no longer listed as active owners before T12 activation.
Reconcile UPSTREAM_BINDINGS/PREBUILD_CONTRACT/TASK_PACKET assumptions against the exact accepted T10/T11 public interfaces and stable IDs.
Apply the emitted @reservation:T12 PATH_OWNERSHIP patch through the integration owner.
Claim T12 with workstream.py as ASSIGNED using the exact current integration head and @reservation:T12.
Set T12 dependency-graph/task-gate active state consistently through integration-owner governance update.
Validate registry and planned ownership collision checks.
Create havenline/T12-progression-architecture from the exact post-activation integration head.
Require candidate guard PASS before shipping T12 runtime/data expands.
Run validate_progression_contract.py against every shipping progression dataset revision before candidate review.
claim_template: python3 tools/havenline/production/workstream.py claim T12 --owner progression-architecture-builder --branch havenline/T12-progression-architecture --base <POST_T11_INTEGRATION_SHA> --owned-alias @reservation:T12 --status ASSIGNED
notes: T12 governance/tooling preparation may continue while T09/T10/T11 runtime work is unfinished; shipping T12 runtime/data remain dependency-gated.
T12 owns Level 1–100 progression topology and cadence contracts; T13 owns adaptive difficulty/Challenge Director behavior.
T12 may consume T10/T11 public transform/camp-state IDs after approval but may not change their transaction or content semantics.
T14 owns global persistence/versioning; T33+ own economy/monetization; T44-T52 own authored connected-region content.
Parallel production is allowed only with disjoint path ownership; integration remains serial and integration-owner controlled.
The non-shipping cadence blueprint and validator/tests are preparation accelerators, not evidence that T12 production implementation has started.
